rollback_triggers.event: qemu_rafaelia commit recovery succeeds BUT androidx_RmR ABI validation fails
rollback_triggers.action: PRESERVE qemu recovery decision; MARK androidx as TOKEN_VAZIO_ABI_MISMATCH; WAIT for next androidx release or compatibility study
preserve: qemu recovery decision logged in event envelope
do_not: Promote ABI mismatch to implicit PASS
Merge qemu changes without androidx fix
rollback_triggers.next_action: Contact androidx_RmR maintainer; document incompatibility; schedule compatibility study

rollback_triggers.event: android-ci workflow passes O1-O8 gates BUT physical device execution fails
rollback_triggers.condition: Workflow conclusion=success but subsequent device test fails
rollback_triggers.action: RECORD device failure as EXPECTED gap (O8 rule); DO NOT promote local success to device capability; maintain PARTIAL state
preserve: Explicit TOKEN_VAZIO recording for device runtime
do_not: Claim runtime success based on CI alone
rollback_triggers.next_action: Gap remains open; escalate for Vectras-VM-Android full stack deployment planning

rollback_triggers.event: Schema changes break existing product_graph.v1.json validators
rollback_triggers.condition: Validation error: unknown field OR type mismatch in nodes/edges validation
rollback_triggers.action: RESTORE previous schema version in contracts; DESIGN v2 schema in parallel; DOCUMENT incompatibility
preserve: Both v1 and v2 schemas in repository
rollback_triggers.next_action: Create migration validator; test backward compatibility; plan coordinated v2 rollout

rollback_triggers.event: Orchestrator gate rules violated (e.g., TOKEN_VAZIO promoted without next_verifiable_step)
rollback_triggers.condition: Validation check finds gap record missing required next_verifiable_step field
rollback_triggers.action: BLOCK commit; REQUIRE gap completion before merge; DO NOT weaken invariant
rollback_triggers.next_action: Fix gap records; re-run validation; commit only after passing

evidence_preservation.no_silent_regressions: Every decision recorded with timestamp + decision_maker + rationale
evidence_preservation.contradictions_kept: When evidence conflicts, both versions recorded + escalation marker added
evidence_preservation.audit_trail_accessible: All rollback decisions visible in git history + separate audit ledger

rollback_execution.if_full_rollback_needed: git reset --hard HEAD~6 (before phase 2 commits); rebuild plan
rollback_execution.if_partial_rollback_needed: git revert specific commits; preserve all evidence files
rollback_execution.if_amendment_needed: Create new commit (never amend) with corrected decision; record reason

guardian_rules: No automatic rollback without human review
Every rollback decision becomes a new audit entry
Rollback does not delete evidence; only suspends forward motion
All gaps marked as TOKEN_VAZIO_BLOCKED_BY_ROLLBACK until resolved

r3.F_gap: Rollback procedures not yet tested; audit ledger structure not yet implemented
